answer: Each agent commits an ember identity in a consensus contract; an SGX/TPM enclave emits a zero-knowledge attestation binding its code, hardware key, and pulse nonce to the ember state tree, while a VDF in the nectar verification circuit enforces sequential work. Forging identities requires distinct provisioned silicon and key extraction; the quadratic bond O(N^2) is irreversibly slashed on duplicate proofs, making Sybil expansion economically superlinear.
